description: This Java class 'GlobalExceptionHandler' is a Spring Boot component that handles exceptions globally across the application. It provides methods to handle specific exceptions and generate appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring ControllerAdvice class that intercepts exceptions thrown in the application and returns appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleGlobalException
methods.description: Handles the custom SimpleBankingGlobalException and returns a ResponseEntity with error details.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles generic exceptions and returns a ResponseEntity with a generic error message.
